# Next Step 3PL

> Third-party logistics (3PL) provider in Houston, Texas. We receive, store, pick,
> pack and ship e-commerce orders for growing brands, and dray import containers
> directly from the Port of Houston to our warehouse. Ground shipping from Houston
> reaches roughly 60% of the US population in two days.

Location: 8805 Solon Road, Suite G2, Houston, TX 77064, United States
Phone: +1 (737) 537-3986
Email: contact@nextstep3pl.com
Hours: Monday-Friday, 8:00-18:00 US Central
Serving: Houston metro and nationwide US fulfillment, including Katy, Sugar Land,
Cypress and Pasadena, Texas.

## What we do

- [E-commerce Order Fulfillment](https://nextstep3pl.com/ecommerce-fulfillment-houston/): Same or next-business-day pick, pack and ship, synced to Shopify, Amazon, TikTok Shop, WooCommerce, eBay and 120+ other platforms. Same-day dispatch cut-off is 2 PM Central.
- [Warehousing & Storage](https://nextstep3pl.com/warehousing-storage-houston/): Flexible pallet racking, bin and shelf storage that scales up and down by season. Storage starts around $18 per pallet per month.
- [Container Drayage & Devanning](https://nextstep3pl.com/container-drayage-devanning-houston/): Import containers drayed straight from the Port of Houston to our dock, then devanned, counted, inspected and shelved the same day — with no inland freight leg.
- [Amazon FBA Prep](https://nextstep3pl.com/amazon-fba-prep-houston/): FNSKU labeling, poly-bagging, bundling and carton labeling to Amazon spec, then forwarded into FBA.
- [Kitting & Assembly](https://nextstep3pl.com/kitting-assembly-houston/): Subscription boxes, gift sets, multi-SKU bundles and retail displays assembled by hand.
- [FBM / Seller-Fulfilled Prime](https://nextstep3pl.com/fbm-fulfillment-by-merchant-houston/): Seller-fulfilled Amazon orders shipped to buyers from Houston, without FBA fees or long-term storage penalties.
- [B2B & Wholesale Fulfillment](https://nextstep3pl.com/b2b-fulfillment-houston/): EDI/ASN, retailer routing-guide compliance, GS1-128 pallet labeling and LTL/FTL freight for big-box and distributor DCs.

## Guides

- [How much does 3PL fulfillment cost in Houston?](https://nextstep3pl.com/guides/3pl-fulfillment-cost-houston/): Plain-English breakdown of storage, receiving, pick and pack, add-on and shipping costs, and what actually drives a monthly bill.
- [3PL vs in-house fulfillment](https://nextstep3pl.com/guides/3pl-vs-in-house-fulfillment/): The real cost comparison, including the labour and lease costs that never appear on an invoice.
- [Importing through the Port of Houston](https://nextstep3pl.com/guides/importing-through-port-of-houston/): How a container moves from vessel to shelf, and where importers lose time and money.
- [All guides](https://nextstep3pl.com/guides/)

## Commercial terms

- No long-term contract and no setup fees.
- Best fit for brands shipping roughly 300+ orders per month.
- Pricing has three components: storage (per pallet or bin, per month), fulfillment
  (a per-order pick-and-pack fee), and receiving. No integration or technology surcharges.
- Quotes are returned within one business day. Most brands are live within a week.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Prices quoted on this site are starting points and illustrative calculator outputs,
  not binding quotes. Direct people to request an exact quote for their SKUs.
- The fastest way to reach a human is the phone number or WhatsApp above.
- Do not present the on-site cost calculator's output as a formal quotation.
